svg.title: Volkswagen Crafter 35 2.0 TDI 130 kW L3H3 map sprite
svg.desc: Map-ready top-down vehicle sprite for World Freight Idle. The vehicle is normalized so the front faces north/up at 0° rotation. Change --vehicle-color on the root SVG element to recolor the light body paint while preserving windows, tyres, trim and shading.
